sources.title: Run Basal-omni-1.0-mini API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: Remek/basal-omni-1.0-mini is an experimental 7.9 billion parameter model based on Google's Gemma 4 E4B architecture, designed for making fast, intuitive, typed decisions. It processes a 'state' (text, images, or audio) and provides a calibrated probability for each allowed answer in a single forward pass, without generating text. This model excels at classification and decision-making tasks ...
